title: S0 follow-ups — CI, packaging, platform and dependency work
objective: Finish the verification, packaging, platform and dependency-review follow-ups retained after S0 acceptance, without expanding into editor features.
context_summary: S0 (the JPEG-at-Fit viewer) is accepted on native M4 evidence. These are its remaining follow-ups: fresh hosted CI verification, Windows/Linux packaging and desktop checks, an optional Linux VM route, the license/asset audit and the two expiring advisory exceptions. Native Windows/Linux desktop and manual license reviews are deferred by the owner until requested.

tasks.description: Automate dependency, license, asset and advisory checks.
extra_context: Pinned cargo-deny 0.20.2 enforces configured three-target license/source/advisory policy. Reviewed exact-version exceptions for paste 1.0.15 and ttf-parser 0.25.1 expire exclusively on 2026-12-18 and 2026-10-19 respectively.
Local policy checks and the hosted baseline at c0ad340 pass. Full asset/native notice review remains incomplete and deferred; this task is not completed or a current S0 acceptance prerequisite.

context_links.label: S0 skeleton contract
context_links.relevance: Defines the load-only scope and three-platform acceptance.

acceptance_criteria: Record licenses/notices for exact enabled runtime dependencies, native libraries, fonts and other bundled assets.
Select/pin open-source dependency/advisory checking tools and document reviewable exceptions rather than a blanket ignore.
Use the accepted license disposition; keep notices and dependency versions traceable to build artifacts.
Run the configured checks and report actual unresolved findings; do not claim a dependency policy merely from top-level crate names.

steps: Inspect the locked graph and enabled native features.
Verify an intentionally incompatible temporary sample is reported by the chosen policy check.
Review advisory results and any narrowly scoped exception.
expected_results: Run the configured checks and report actual unresolved findings; do not claim a dependency policy merely from top-level crate names.

tasks.description: Add the three-platform build and check CI workflow.
extra_context: Three-platform hosted checks/packages pass at c0ad340. The expanded closure workflow at 6b13871 has no hosted result; current source/runtime-import/package verification remains unfinished.

context_links.label: S0 skeleton contract
context_links.relevance: Defines the load-only scope and three-platform acceptance.

acceptance_criteria: Run locked builds, core tests, formatting/lint and plan/document checks for the accepted macOS/Windows/Linux matrix.
Pin/configure CI dependencies and cache keys by toolchain/target/profile without relying on undeclared global tools.
Keep GUI smoke separate from display-free checks and make all equivalent commands available locally.
CI results report the exact platform/architecture and retain useful build/test failure output.

steps: Run or validate the workflow on available runners and record missing execution access.
Check a clean dependency-cache build and a deliberate failing check.
Confirm local runner and CI commands match.
expected_results: CI results report the exact platform/architecture and retain useful build/test failure output.

tasks.description: Package the S0 skeleton for Windows.
extra_context: Windows packages passed for the hosted c0ad340 baseline. Fresh closure-snapshot packaging/runtime-import inspection remains unfinished; no native Windows desktop acceptance is implied.

context_links.label: S0 skeleton contract
context_links.relevance: Defines the load-only scope and three-platform acceptance.

acceptance_criteria: Implement host packaging for the accepted Windows architecture/runtime matrix as a executable/runtime archive.
Include required native libraries/assets/notices, build identity and checksums; document any external runtime prerequisite.
Make package creation callable through the shared runner without public signing, store submission or an auto-updater.
Produce an install/unpack-and-launch artifact whose later smoke evidence can be tied to the exact tested binary, not an older build.

steps: Build from pinned inputs and inspect the assembled artifact.
Check dynamic/runtime dependencies and verify assets/notices are included.
Record actual package commands and remaining clean-environment checks.
expected_results: Produce an install/unpack-and-launch artifact whose later smoke evidence can be tied to the exact tested binary, not an older build.

Software-renderer checks are not native desktop/GPU evidence.

acceptance_criteria: Run smoke scenarios where a suitable desktop/render environment exists and label backend/software/virtual conditions.
